attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created group inventory-readers and user inventorysvc, then set ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers with 750 on directories and 640 on files, preserving all existing data. Verified access control by testing with a group-member user (read succeeded) and an unrelated user (permission denied), then cleaned up the test accounts. Completed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a boot_id/data-checksum baseline, issued a native `reboot`, polled through the outage, confirmed a changed boot_id after recovery, and re-verified ownership, permissions, and identical data checksums post-restart.
